name: Hover Displacement Image
description: A single WebGL image that warps with a chromatic radial displacement when hovered or touched, easing smoothly in and out through a custom fragment shader.
contents: One WebGL-rendered image plane centered in the viewport
behavior: Hover or touch eases a shader progress uniform from 0 to 1 with GSAP, producing a radial zoom distortion with RGB channel separation
Leaving or releasing eases the effect back
Plane scales to the container width up to a max width, height adapts to viewport

needsCodeEdit.where: h-[calc(50vw+180px)] sm:h-[70vh] classes on the planeRef div

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Image must allow cross-origin loading for WebGL textures
